Title: Seawatch Bay
Content: People on an evening fishing trip in Seawatch Bay notice that the water faintly glows at night. The glow in the water is stronger around their boat as it moves through the bay. They collect a water sample and send it to a marine science lab for analysis.

Scientists examine the water sample under a microscope. They find a microorganism named Noctiluca scintillans. The Noctiluca scintillans in the water sample exhibits `text(two)` different traits. Some of the microorganisms in this species can produce light, while others cannot.
The Noctiluca scintillans that can produce light make a protein called luciferase. The luciferase protein helps drive a chemical reaction that releases light.
